summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market repurchases of its ordinary shares under existing buyback programmes announced 30 January and 31 July 2026. Between 24-28 August 2026, the company bought over 67 million shares at prices between 108.75p and 112.35p, intending to cancel them. Goldman Sachs International acted as broker. The filing is a routine issuer buyback disclosure, reflecting ongoing capital return. What to watch: continued execution pace and impact on share count and EPS.
